Pranav Srinivasan · pranav.srinivasan70@example.com · +91 9898820262
Whitefield, Bangalore

Professional Summary
Analytical finance professional with cross-functional experience in FP&A, financial modeling and cloud infrastructure support for product and engineering teams. Skilled at building forecasting models, automating reporting processes, and collaborating with engineering to optimize cost and performance. Open to relocation anywhere in India. Notice period: 30 days.

Technical Skills
Financial Modeling, FP&A, Microsoft Excel, IFRS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Confluence

Work Experience

Senior Financial Analyst, Ledgerly (May 2022 - Present)
- Built rolling 18-month FP&A models and quarterly forecasts using Microsoft Excel to support monthly board reporting; reduced forecast variance from 12% to 4% for core revenue lines.
- Implemented FP&A-driven scenario analyses and sensitivity models in Excel to evaluate pricing and subscription churn impacts, enabling a 7% margin improvement on targeted product bundles.
- Partnered with engineering to tag cloud spend and translate Kubernetes cluster and Terraform-managed infra costs into product P&L buckets, improving cost allocation accuracy for three product teams.
- Documented forecasting processes and assumptions in Confluence to standardize monthly close and variance review workflows.

FP&A Manager, UrbanPantry (Sep 2017 - Apr 2022)
- Led budgeting and monthly FP&A cadence for marketplace and operations, creating consolidated financial models in Microsoft Excel to track unit economics and contribution margins across 12 city markets.
- Designed IFRS-compliant reporting templates and maintained close coordination with accounting; accelerated month-end close by 30% through standardized templates and reconciliations.
- Performed scenario planning and long-range financial modeling to inform expansion decisions, producing actionable insights that prioritized three high-ROI city launches.
- Maintained process documentation in Confluence for budgeting, forecasting and KPI definitions to enable cross-functional adoption.

Cloud Engineer, Pixelwave Studios (Mar 2016 - Aug 2017)
- Managed Kubernetes clusters and deployed microservices using Terraform for infrastructure provisioning, improving deployment repeatability and reducing environment setup time by 60%.
- Automated infrastructure deployments and CI/CD workflows with Terraform scripts and Kubernetes manifests, enabling reliable staging and production rollouts for game backend services.
- Created runbooks and architecture documentation in Confluence to streamline on-call responses and knowledge transfer between dev and ops teams.

Education
MCA, Symbiosis
